chapterTitle: Federal Board Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Guess Paper 4)
subject: math-10

questions.question: A 4 cm long chord subtends a central angle of 60°. The radial segment of this circle is:
questions.explanation: The central triangle with angle 60° and equal radii arms is equilateral, so radius = chord = 4 cm.

questions.question: The length of a chord and the radial segment of a circle are congruent. The central angle made by the chord will be:
questions.explanation: All three sides of the central triangle are equal, making each angle 60°.

questions.question: Out of two congruent arcs of circle, if one arc makes a central angle of 30°, then the other arc will subtend a central angle of:
questions.explanation: Congruent arcs of a circle subtend equal central angles.

questions.question: An arc subtends a central angle of 40°. Then the corresponding chord will subtend a central angle of:
questions.explanation: The chord connects the same endpoints as the arc, subtending the same 40° at the centre.

questions.question: A pair of chords of a circle subtending two congruent central angles are:
questions.explanation: Equal central angles correspond to equal chords.

questions.question: A fraction in which the degree of numerator is less than the degree of denominator is called a/an:
questions.explanation: When deg(N) < deg(D), the rational fraction is proper.

questions.question: A fraction in which the degree of numerator is greater than or equal to the degree of denominator is called a/an:
questions.explanation: When deg(N) ≥ deg(D), it is an improper rational fraction.

questions.question: (x + 3)² = x² + 6x + 9 is a/an:
questions.explanation: It holds true for all values of x, satisfying the definition of an algebraic identity.

questions.question: The partial fraction form of (x - 2) / [(x - 1)(x + 2)] is:
questions.explanation: Non-repeated linear denominator factors decompose into A/(x - 1) + B/(x + 2).

questions.question: The partial fraction form of (x + 2) / [(x + 1)(x² + 2)] is:
questions.explanation: The irreducible quadratic factor (x² + 2) takes a linear numerator (Bx + C).

questions.question: Which of the following is an improper fraction?
questions.explanation: Degree of numerator is 2, denominator is 1. Since 2 > 1, it is improper.

questions.question: Which of the following is a proper fraction?
questions.explanation: Degree of numerator (1) is less than degree of denominator (2), so it is proper.

questions.question: The number of partial fractions of (x² + 1) / [(x - 1)(x + 2)(x - 3)] is:
questions.explanation: Three distinct linear factors yield 3 partial fractions.

questions.question: An arc of a circle subtends an angle at the centre which is:

options.A: Double the angle subtended at the circumference
options.B: Equal to the angle at circumference

questions.explanation: Central angle is always twice the inscribed angle subtended by the same arc.

questions.question: If two arcs of a circle are equal in length, their chords are:
questions.explanation: Equal arcs intercept chords of equal length.
